name: Chin's Szechwan - Rancho Bernardo
notes: Read from the restaurant's own dine-in menu PDF linked from govisitchins.com (Bento site builder). Menu carries a Lunch/Dinner two-tier price for most entrees; both prices filed as separate dishes with '— Lunch'/'— Dinner' section suffixes. PDF footer says 'Items & pricing may vary per location', so cross-checked against Grubhub for this specific Rancho Bernardo location: Kung Pao Chicken (dinner $23.95 PDF vs $24.95 Grubhub), Mongolian Beef ($24.95 vs $25.95), Szechwan Garlic Chicken ($23.95 vs $24.95), Lo Mein ($18.95 vs $19.95+) all agree to within a flat +$1.00 Grubhub delivery upcharge - not divided out, corroborates the PDF is this location's pricing. A handful of items in the source PDF (Szechwan Garlic Beef, Tangerine Beef, Szechwan Garlic Pork, Szechwan Garlic Eggplant, Szechwan Garlic Eggplant & Tofu, Tofu in Brown Sauce, Spicy Honey & Sesame Double Delight) had no price printed on their own row (a PDF layout artifact) and were dropped rather than inferred from their category's price. Adjunct modifier add-ons (extra protein/vegetable/sauce charges, extra pancake skins) excluded as adjuncts, not dishes.
